newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close down, Finance One tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close down, Finance One tumbles.

text.p: Thai stocks ended Tuesday lower after heavy selling of bank and finance issues on concern over the financial sector outlook and rising non-performing loans, brokers said.
The SET index dropped 6.78 points to close at 556.57 on thin 2.5 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index fell 0.54 points to 40.35.
"New buying interest remains thin. The market won't see any sharp rebound until we see clearer solutions for loan problems in the finance sector," said an analyst at United Securities.
Finance One led the finance sector's decline, dropping 0.60 baht to its 10-percent daily limit low of 5.70. The issue topped the active list with 239 million baht of shares changing hands.
"Some investors were unwilling to exercise their right to buy Finance One's new shares at higher than the market price. So they tried to sell the issue today," the broker said.
Finance One said it will float a new 2-for-1 rights issue at 7.50 baht each. The stock exchange on Tuesday set the ex-rights date on June 4-9.
